# Support

This is a single-maintainer, internal automation library — there is no SLA
and no dedicated support team, but questions are welcome.

- **Have a question, or not sure if something is a bug?** Open a
  [Q&A discussion](https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-automation/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **Have a rough idea or proposal that isn't ready to be filed as work yet?**
  Post it in
  [Ideas](https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-automation/discussions/categories/ideas).
  See [`docs/contributing/filing-work.md`](../docs/contributing/filing-work.md)
  for how an idea becomes a tracked issue.
- **Found a bug, or want to propose a concrete feature?** Use the
  [issue templates](https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-automation/issues/new/choose).
- **Found a security vulnerability?** Do not open a public issue — report it
  privately via
  [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-automation/security/advisories/new).
  See [`.github/SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md).

See [`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to contribute code.
